Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		overdueUsers: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0)
	precondition:
		overdueUsers.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		overdueUsers->forAll(u: User|if u.SuspensionDays>1 
		then u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays-1 and
		u.BorrowStatus = User::SUSPEND 
		else u.SuspensionDays = 0 and
		u.BorrowStatus = User::SUSPEND 
		endif )
}
